caseNameFull: Durocher v. Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. Motion to proceed in forma pauperis without an affidavit of indigency executed by petitioner granted. Certiorari dismissed. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Justice Ginsburg took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion, petition, and application.
